items.title: Oi prices choppy as recovering Hormuz Strait traffic tempers war premium
items.description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said in a note on Friday that stronger oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz had eased market concerns after U.S.-Iran strikes earlier this week.

items.title: Coinbase shares fall after crypto exchange posts disappointing second-quarter results
items.description: Coinbase's Thursday report marked its third straight quarter missing Wall Street's forecasts for revenue and earnings.

items.title: A portfolio manager says investors are looking overseas as Magnificent Seven worries grow. Here are the stocks and sectors he favors
items.description: Janus Henderson’s Julian McManus says investors are looking overseas as Magnificent Seven concentration worries revive diversification.

items.title: Apple drops 7%, Amazon surges 12% as investors pick AI winners after earnings
items.description: Shares of Amazon jumped sharply in premarket trading on Friday while Apple dropped as investors digest earnings.

items.title: SK Hynix, Samsung shares skyrocket to clock best days as AI rally roars back
items.description: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.

items.title: Deadly storms and a global supply squeeze are sending copper prices soaring
items.description: Deadly storms in Chile have disrupted mining operations, further straining supply and potentially driving prices higher, strategists say.

items.title: Iran targets strategic U.S. assets in Kuwait, Bahrain after Egypt drone attack
items.description: Iran's army said it launched attacks on strategic U.S. assets and military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

items.title: Fast-fashion retailer Shein’s 3-year IPO odyssey may have cost it the ‘golden time’ to go public
items.description: Investors are questioning whether Beijing's blessing can carry a $40-billion-plus valuation for a clothing retailer whose growth engine is stalling.

items.title: CXMT's blockbuster debut in Shanghai sets stage for next test against global memory giants
items.description: The company faces a challenge as it does not have access to the latest extreme ultraviolet, or EUV, lithography machines, essential for manufacturing advanced chips.

items.title: BOJ holds rates at 1%, warns of core inflation exceeding 2% target
items.description: The decision comes as speculation continues to swirl around whether the Bank of Japan will hike rates at a faster pace.

items.title: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracts in July on demand slump, typhoons
items.description: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracted in July, as the export rush that powered a second-quarter rebound began to unwind.

items.title: South Korea's 'bipolar' stock market: meltdowns, a record rally and what's to come
items.description: South Korea's stock market staged its sharpest reversal on record on Friday, capping a month of wild swings.

items.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
items.description: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.

items.title: We're raising our Apple price target, seeing plenty of good despite the memory crunch knocks
items.description: It was a good but not great quarter as Apple worked to mitigate the memory shortage, which impacted the reported quarter and guidance.

items.title: Tim Cook sees Apple's hybrid AI strategy as a 'competitive weapon'
items.description: Ahead of the launch of Siri AI, Apple's outgoing CEO Tim Cook said the company will charge for artificial intelligence through iCloud.

items.title: Reddit CEO says Google's AI Overviews can't replace '10 blue links' for referral traffic
items.description: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said his company has to find ways to work around changes at Google, which is delivering less traffic than in the past.

items.title: Indonesian state telecom said to weigh sale of venture arm managing $830 million
items.description: Indonesia's state-owned telecom giant is exploring a sale of MDI Ventures, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Microsoft's Xbox chief lays out plan to pass rivals on margin by 2030 in memo to employees
items.description: Microsoft's gaming unit wants to invest in its Minecraft franchise and expand through partnerships, including in China.

items.title: Amazon got $600 million in Trump tariff refunds and will pass return along to some customers
items.description: The company previously hadn't disclosed whether it would recoup tariff costs after the Supreme Court ruled many of President Donald Trump's levies were illegal.

items.title: IBM CEO says quantum computing will have a 'measurable impact' on earnings by 2028 or 2029
items.description: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna said the company's investments in quantum computing should begin to have "a measurable impact" on revenue and earnings by 2028 or 2029.
